title: Resource methods rejected standard request metadata
summary: Initial new resources/list and resources/read validation rejected standard optional _meta objects, causing valid clients with progress/request metadata to fail. Fixed before delivery by allowing and type-checking optional object metadata only on resource method params, preserving strict tool arguments; regression passed in final34-case native and sanitizer suites; independently reinspected.
evidence: verification.md, Embedding review defects and fixes; detailed final regressions in verification-embedding.md.

resolution.evidence: verification-embedding.md final native34/34 andASan/UBSan34/34; focused fragment/metadata regressions and independent source reinspection recorded in quality-review-embedding.md.
